label: Behçet’s disease
summary: Bounded human Behçet disease overview: HLA/ERAP1 and cytokine-locus susceptibility, T-cell and neutrophil activation, NET/coagulation and endothelial injury, plus mucocutaneous, ocular, vascular, neurologic, joint and intestinal branches. Primary-report associations, culture mechanisms and intervention populations remain distinct. Excludes monogenic mimics, diagnostic criteria and comprehensive treatment guidance.
